subject: Model variant gaps — snapshot request, diff check, and pin proposal
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@finflow.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up after today’s demo — unexpected behavior after model update

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the latency improvements are great and we liked the ability to route based on cost tiers. We started a small integration smoke test this afternoon and noticed an uptick in answer hallucinations for the "invoice parsing" prompts compared to what we saw last week.

Specifics:
- Example prompt set row IDs: 23, 91, 117 (attached CSV)
- Observed: Previously correct extraction of invoice totals, now ~15% mismatch on numeric fields
- Model reported in headers: redwood-xlarge-v2 (updated automatically at 2027-05-28 02:10 UTC)

We need to understand: is there a known model variant change that could explain a quality delta? Immediate asks:
1) Can you snapshot the request/response pairs we sent and run a quick diff against the previous pinned variant (if available)?
2) If a regression is confirmed, can you suggest a short-term pin (which model id + timestamp) and a rollback window?
3) Please share the eval pack you used for the invoice extractor so we can reproduce locally.

We’re preparing a short internal note for procurement because this touches SLAs. I can make time for a quick triage call if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Integrations | FinFlow

Attachments:
- customer_prompt_set_v2.csv (attachment stub)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finflow.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after today’s demo — unexpected behavior after model update

Elena — thanks for flagging and for the concrete examples, that helps a lot. Quick recap / next steps from our side: 

1) Snapshot & diff: we will capture a request/response snapshot for the time window you reported (today 15:00–16:00 UTC). I’ve asked Rishi to run a diff against the last-known stable snapshot we have for your account (2027-05-22T21:40:00Z).

2) Short-term mitigation: propose pinning to redwood-xlarge-v1 (build tag 20270518-08) for FinFlow while we triage. That variant matched your earlier observations in our evals. Pin would be temporary (72 hours) unless you sign off on extended pin.

3) Eval pack: attaching the Redwood invoice-eval pack we ran in the demo (includes golden set, metric scripts, and prompts). Also shared a Drive folder with the bench scripts and a HubSpot ticket.

4) Timing / escalation: we can run an expedited diff tonight and share a one-page summary by Monday 10:00 PT. If diff >5% F1 drop on numeric extraction, we’ll recommend immediate pin + rollback plan.

If it’s ok with you I’ll go ahead and snapshot your traffic for the window and run the automated diff. I’ll only proceed with an enforced pin after we confirm the regression and get your OK.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood_eval_pack_v2.zip (attachment stub)
Links:
- https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-finflow-eval
- HubSpot: HS-234572-Opportunity

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 12:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: plan for FinFlow snapshot/diff/pin (technical steps)

Laura / Marissa —

Quick ops runbook (I’ll take lead tonight):
- Step 1: Ingest Elena’s attached prompt_set into our eval harness (invoice-extract-suite). Run against stored snapshot for redwood-xlarge-v1 (tag 20270518-08) and current redwood-xlarge-v2.
- Step 2: Compute per-row metrics (F1 numeric, precision/recall for date/amount fields). Produce a delta report.
- Step 3: If delta > 5% absolute F1 drop on amount extraction, trigger a temporary pin via the customer routing API: POST /customers/finflow/pin {model: "redwood-xlarge-v1", expires: 72h}.
- Step 4: Generate diff_snapshot_20270530.json and attach to the HubSpot ticket.

Caveats / notes:
- We should confirm customer opt-in before enforcing a pin in production. Pinning affects routing for all production keys for their account.
- If we see degradation limited to multi-line invoices, we may instead apply a prompt template tweak and a KV-cache cold-start policy (less disruptive).

I’ll run the eval and post results in the ticket by 02:00 PT. Laura — if you want me to hold before creating the pin, say so; otherwise I’ll prepare the API call but wait for explicit Elena approval.

Rishi
Principal Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detail. Please proceed with the snapshot and automated diff. We grant permission to prepare the API pin call but do not enforce it until we see the delta report.

If you confirm a regression >5% on the numeric fields, please go ahead and apply the 72-hour pin while we schedule a joint review. Procurement is looped here — they’ll want the diff_snapshot and the summary for impact assessment.

Also — can you include in the report any differences in tokenization/normalization between v1 and v2 that might affect numeric parsing? That’s one hypothesis on our side.

Elena
Head of Integrations | FinFlow
